notes: next_task with task claims that task for the session if it is assigned to the agent and eligible, and returns the same body as next_task.json. Otherwise it returns HTTP 200 with {"task": null, "reason": <code>} and takes no lease. Reasons, checked in this order: unsafe_id (the id fails capabilities.id_pattern), not_assigned, closed (done, abandoned or archived; an addition to the v2.3 list), provisional (done by an agent, waiting for the owner), on_hold, blocked (blocked state or an open dependency), open_children, waiting_on_ask (an unanswered blocking ask), over_budget (spent reached the allowance in either unit; raising the allowance makes it eligible again), leased (another session holds a live lease). A task outside the subtree is refused with HTTP 409 wrong_scope as on every call.
